newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 2.004 billion yuan from 1.233 billion yuan with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.
Traders said head offices of state banks traded more on the market Tuesday, pushing up the volume.
They said the believed the banks would trade more and more since Beijing ordered them to exit the stock and state debt secondary markets.
The People's Bank of China, the central bank, last week issued an urgent notice, ordering the banks to trade their short-term funds only on the interbank market.
Traders said they expected turnover on the interbank market to rise solidly in the mid-term but the interbank rates to move in a narrow range in the short term.
